QUESTIONS PEOPLE ASK BEFORE HIRING US FOR YOUTUBE ADS
Answers written and reviewed by Khalid Farhan, founder. Last reviewed November 2026.
How much do YouTube Ads cost?
YouTube CPVs (cost per view) typically range from €0.01–€0.05. You only pay when someone watches at least 30 seconds or clicks. We recommend €1,000+/month ad spend to generate meaningful data.
Do I need a YouTube channel to run YouTube Ads?
Yes. You'll need a YouTube channel and a Google Ads account linked together. We handle the setup as part of onboarding.
Can I run YouTube Ads alongside Google Search?
Absolutely — in fact, we recommend combining YouTube (awareness and consideration) with Google Search (intent capture) as a unified paid strategy.
